Three useful starting actions

  1. Separate the essential needs of home from those of the business.
  2. Identify people, resources and dependencies shared between them.
  3. Agree responsibilities and keep both plans reviewed.
Where do your home and business responsibilities overlap?

When a printable plan helps

The Complete Library brings together READY/01–10: the household topics plus Business / 72 Hours. Save £2.99 compared with Household Library (£19.99) and Business / 72 Hours (£12.99) bought separately.

The free resources do not require buying a plan. Prices and purchase terms are shown at checkout.

Use alongside current guidance

READY/ helps organise decisions. During an incident, follow current instructions from emergency services, utilities, relevant professionals and public authorities. For equipment and household systems, use the manufacturer’s instructions and qualified help where required.
